name: Is specialty bathroom paint worth the investment over standard paint?

mainEntity.name: Is specialty bathroom paint worth the investment over standard paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Specialty bathroom paints contain antimicrobial additives and tighter resin binders that resist constant humidity, wiping, and mildew growth far better than standard wall paints. Standard interior latex paints are formulated for bedrooms or living areas with normal humidity; in an unventilated or heavily used bathroom, they can absorb steam, soften, and peel. While premium kitchen-and-bath formulas cost slightly more per gallon, the tradeoff is significant longevity. HH Remodeling uses moisture-resistant products to ensure your bathroom walls withstand repeated shower steam without degrading the finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Specialty bathroom paints contain antimicrobial agents and moisture barriers that prevent peeling, water marks, and mildew far better than standard paint.
